placements.why: The organization establishes ongoing operational recovery verification and rollback drills as a core resilience discipline.
placements.title: Continuous verification of recovery and fault-tolerance mechanisms
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, test, and govern its recovery strategies and operational resilience?

placements.title: Rollback capability exists only when proven through regular rehearsal
placements.frame: How is operational rollback readiness validated and maintained as a genuine capability rather than an assumed one?
placements.why: Quinton Fairweather establishes a mandatory monthly rehearsal cadence grounded in the principle that an unrehearsed rollback cannot be considered an actual capability.
